Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Line No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the location that is used as the transfer-from location for the transfer order when the system delivery list line is added to a transfer order. Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Location Code/Trsf.-from Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the lot number of the item on the line. This field is used to track the specific batch of items that is being sold, and is required when the item requires lot number tracking. When you click on the lookup button in this field, you can select from the available lot numbers for the item based on the source document line, such as a sales order line or transfer order line, that is associated with this system delivery list line.

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field No. - Property Caption

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Order Line No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the order for which the system delivery list line will be added. This field is used together with the Order Type field to determine whether the system delivery list line will be added to a specific order. When both the Order Type and Order No. match the type and number of the order being created, the system delivery list line will be added to that order.

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of order for which the system delivery list line will be added. The order type can be either a sales order or a transfer order. When the specified order type matches the type of the order being created, the system delivery list line will be added to that order.

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Order Type - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of source document that was created when the system delivery list line was posted. This field is used for reference purposes to link the system delivery list line to the specific source document, such as a sales order or transfer order, that was created when the system delivery list line was processed.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source Document - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source Document - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the line number of the source document line that was created when the system delivery list line was posted. This field is used for reference purposes to link the system delivery list line to the specific line on the source document, such as a sales order line or transfer order line, that was created when the system delivery list line was processed.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source Line No. - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source Line No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the number of the source document that was created when the system delivery list line was posted. This field is used for reference purposes to link the system delivery list line to the specific source document, such as a sales order or transfer order, that was created when the system delivery list line was processed.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source No. - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posted Source No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the date when the system delivery list line was posted. This field is used for reference purposes to track when the line was processed and added to a sales order or transfer order.

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Posting Date - Property Caption

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Quantity (Base) - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the reason code to be used on the sales order line that will be created based on this system delivery list line. The reason code is used to indicate the reason for the transaction, such as a promotion or a special discount, and can be used for reporting and analysis purposes.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Reason Code - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Reason Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Indicates whether the system delivery list line is selected. This field is used in the processing of the system delivery list lines, such as when adding the lines to a sales order. When a line is selected, it means that the line has been processed and added to the sales order.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Selected - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Selected - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the serial number of the item on the line. This field is used to track the specific item that is being sold, and is required when the item requires serial number tracking. When you click on the lookup button in this field, you can select from the available serial numbers for the item based on the source document line, such as a sales order line or transfer order line, that is associated with this system delivery list line.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Serial No. - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Serial No. - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the system delivery list. The system delivery list is used to define the lines that will be automatically added to a sales order when the "System Code" is selected on the sales line. This allows you to automate the addition of related products, such as a container or a pump for a fuel sale.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field System Code - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field System Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the tank. This field is used together with the System Code field to determine which lines will be added to the sales order. When both the System Code and Tank Code match the entries in this table, the defined lines will be added to the sales order.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Tank Code - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Tank Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the tank entry reason code to be used on the sales order line that will be created based on this system delivery list line. The tank entry reason code is used to indicate the reason for the delivery of the fuel, such as a delivery to a customer or a return from a customer, and can be used for reporting and analysis purposes.
trans-unit.note: Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Tank Entry Reason Code - Property ToolTip
Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Tank Entry Reason Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the code of the location that is used as the transfer-to location for the transfer order when the system delivery list line is added to a transfer order. Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Transfer-to Code - Property Caption

trans-unit.source: Specifies the type of entity that will be posted for this sales line, such as Item, Resource, or G/L Account. The type that you enter in this field determines what you can select in the No. field.

Table EOS115 System Delivery List - Field Type - Property Caption
